I will put chemical fertilizer on this barley plot, but not much, because this piece is very small and cash is always tight. I own the land, so I do not want to leave it hungry, and if I miss fertilizer completely the harvest is too weak; I will also carry some manure there from home because that costs me less cash. I will keep using local seed because that is what I know for barley here, I will not irrigate, and I will do the work mostly with my family without hiring unless something goes badly wrong.
